 API Specifications
4.2  Search - Member Company

4.2.1 Vehicle Search - Member Company
Version 1.8.1
URL :   https://uat-api.dmvic.com/api/v6/Integration/VehicleSearch
Method : POST
Note: Please note that X509 client certificate should be installed in your server and to be attached to the header during every request of API
4.2.2  Request Body
4.2.2.1 Body
ParameterMandatory (Y/N)DataTypeData FormatValidation MessageVehicleRegistrationNumberYesKDC324FThe vehicle Registration Number's maximum length is 15 Example Body Content
{
  "VehicleRegistrationNumber": "KDC324F"
}
 
Please find below the sample vehicle registration numbers from the UAT environment that exist in the NTSA records.
4.2.2.2 Headers
Parameter nameMandatory (Yes/No)DataTypeData FormatAuthorizationYesstringBearer << Token received from Login API on Successful login >>ClientIDYesstring<< Will be provided in a separate Email >>4.2.3 Response Elements
ElementsDescriptionExampleInputsContains the input parameters specified by the querySuccessBit value true/false to differentiate if the request is succeeded or not.true/falsecallbackObjIf the request is succeeded, then the Json Object of the following parameters will be returnedPolicyHistory VehicleErrorER001 - Input json format is Incorrect
ER002 - Unknown Error
ER003 - Mandatory field is missingAPIRequestNumberO-AA00014.2.4 Response JSON (Example)
4.2.4.1 Sample Success Response (If the provided vehicle registration number is available in NTSA)
{
  "Vehicle": {
    "RegistrationNumber": "KDC324F",
    "ChassisNumber": "NSP130-2135932",
    "RegistrationYear": "2013",
    "EngineNumber": "1NR-0632177",
    "Make": "TOYOTA",
    "Model": "VITZ",
    "BodyType": "S.WAGON"
  },
  "PolicyHistory": [
    {
      "PolicyNumber": "Business Confidential",
      "TypeOfCover": "Business Confidential",
      "CoverStartDate": "Business Confidential",
      "CoverEndDate": "15/10/2026",
      "MemberCompany": "Business Confidential"
    }
  ],
  "APIRequestNumber": "UAT-OIV9636",
  "success": true
}
4.2.4.2 Sample Response (If the provided vehicle registration number is not available in NTSA)
{
  "Inputs": {
    "VehicleRegistrationNumber": "ABC98475"
  },
  "callbackObj": {
    "Vehicle": {
      "VehicleRegistrationNumber": null,
      "ChassisNumber": null,
      "VehicleRegistrationYear": null,
      "EngineNumber": null,
      "VehicleMake": null,
      "VehicleModel": null,
      "BodyType": null
    },
    "PolicyHistory": []
  },
  "success": true,
  "Error": [],
  "APIRequestNumber": "UAT-OIV9474",
  "DMVICRefNo": null
}



API Specifications
4.4  Issue Certificate - Member Company
There are 5 different types of certificates that can be issued as part of any insurance company. So, each type has an API for the issuance. This will help insurance companies to understand different types of parameters as API inputs for every certificate Type.

4.4.1 For Type A certificates - Member Company
Version 1.8.1
 Purpose:To Issue Type A DMVIC certificate from the insurance companies’ core-system via DMVIC API
URL :   https://uat-api.dmvic.com/api/v6/Integration/IssuanceTypeACertificate
Method : POST
Note: Please note that X509 client certificate should be installed in your server and to be attached to the header during every request of API
4.4.1.1  Request Body
4.4.1.1.1 Body
ParameterMandatory (Y/N)DataTypeData FormatValidation MessageTypeOfCertificateYesint1PSV Unmarked6Type A Bus7Type A Matatu8Type A TaxiType of certificate is wrongIntermediaryIRANumberNostringExample: IRA/06/357/2019TypeofcoverYesint1Comprehensive (COMP)2Third-party (TPO)3Third-party, Theft & Fire (TPTF)Type of Cover is not validPolicyholderYesstringpolicynumberYesstringCommencingdateYesstringDD/MM/YYYY1Commencing Date is invalid2For the below types certificate cannot be issued with future dates Type-A Matatu, Type-A Bus. You cannot issue Future date.Kindly change datesExpiringdateYesstringDD/MM/YYYYRegistrationnumberNostringChassisnumberYesstringThe chassis number minimum length is 4 and maximum length is 20. Only accepts alphanumeric characters and does not support any special charactersPhonenumberYesstring999999999Please enter a valid Kenyan numberBodytypeYesstringLicensedtocarryYesintVehiclemakeNostringVehiclemodelNostringYearofregistrationYesintYYYYEnginenumberNostringEmailYesstring<<Email id to which the Certificate pdf will be sent on successful Issuance>>Email is not validSumInsuredYes (when Comprehensive (COMP) & Third-party, Theft & Fire (TPTF))intNew InsuredPINNew YesNew stringInsured PIN number maximum length is 11New YearofmanufactureNew NoNew intNew YYYYNew HudumaNumberNew NoNew stringNew 123456789012 Example Body Content
{
  "IntermediaryIRANumber": "IRA/XX/XXX/2025",
  "TypeOfCertificate": 7,
  "Typeofcover": 100,
  "Policyholder": "SA",
  "policynumber": "SAPOL123",
  "Commencingdate": "01/11/2025",
  "Expiringdate": "02/11/2025",
  "Registrationnumber": "KCW708R",
  "Chassisnumber": "{{ChassisNumber}}",
  "Phonenumber": "789789789",
  "Bodytype": "{{BodyType}}",
  "Licensedtocarry": 9,
  "Vehiclemake": "{{VehicleMake}}",
  "Vehiclemodel": "{{VehicleModel}}",
  "Enginenumber": "{{EngineNumber}}",
  "Email": "chandrakala@swiftant.com",
  "SumInsured": 100000,
  "InsuredPIN": "A123456789A",
  "Yearofmanufacture": 2019,
  "HudumaNumber": "123456789012"
}
4.4.1.1.2 Headers
Parameter nameMandatory (Y/N)DataTypeData FormatAuthorizationYesstringBearer <<Token received from Login API on Successful login>>ClientIDYesstring<<Will be provided in a separate Email>>4.4.1.2 Response Elements
ElementsDescriptionExampleInputsContains the input parameters specified by the querySuccessBit value true/false to differentiate if the request is succeeded or nottrue/falsecallbackObjIf the request is succeeded, then the Json Object of the following parameters will be returnedTransactionNo
actualCNo
Email- CertificatePDFErrorER001 - Input json format is Incorrect
ER002 - Unknown Error
ER003 - Mandatory field is missing
ER004 - Input not valid
ER005 - Double Insurance
ER006 - No sufficient Inventory
ER007 - Data Validation ErrorAPIRequestNumberO-AA00014.4.1.3 Response JSON (Example)

  "Inputs": {

API Specifications
4.4  Issue Certificate - Member Company

4.4.2 For Type B certificates - Member Company
Version 1.8.1
 Purpose:To Issue Type B DMVIC certificate from the insurance companies’ core-system via DMVIC API
URL :   https://uat-api.dmvic.com/api/v6/Integration/IssuanceTypeBCertificate
Method : POST
Note: Please note that X509 client certificate should be installed in your server and to be attached to the header during every request of API
4.4.2.1  Request Body
4.4.2.1.1 Body
ParameterMandatory (Y/N)DataTypeFormatValidation MessageIntermediaryIRANumberNostringExample: IRA/06/357/2019TypeofcoverYesint100Comprehensive (COMP)200Third-party (TPO)300Third-party, Theft & Fire (TPTF)Type of Cover is not validVehicleTypeYesint1MOTOR COMMERCIAL OWN GOODS2MOTOR COMMERCIAL GENERAL CARTAGE3MOTOR INSTITUTIONAL VEHICLE4MOTOR SPECIAL VEHICLES5TANKERS (LIQUID CARRYING)6MOTOR TRADE (ROAD RISK)PolicyholderYesstringpolicynumberYesstringCommencingdateYesstringDD/MM/YYYYCommencing Date is invalidExpiringdateYesstringDD/MM/YYYYRegistrationnumberNostringChassisnumberYesstringThe chassis number minimum length is 4 and maximum length is 20. Only accepts alphanumeric characters and does not support any special charactersPhonenumberYesstring999999999Please enter a valid Kenyan numberBodytypeYesstringTonnageCarryingCapacityYesintVehiclemakeNostringVehiclemodelNostringYearofregistrationYesintYYYYEnginenumberNostringEmailYesstring<<Email id to which the Certificate pdf will be sent on successful Issuance>>Email is not validSumInsuredYes (when Comprehensive (COMP) & Third-party, Theft & Fire (TPTF))intInsuredPINYesstringInsured PIN number maximum length is 11YearofmanufactureNointYYYYHudumaNumberNostring123456789012New TonnageNew YesNew intNew 10New LicensedtocarryNew Yes(when MOTOR INSTITUTIONAL VEHICLE)New intNew 10 Example Body Content
{
  "IntermediaryIRANumber": "IRA/XX/XXX/2025",
  "vehicletype": 1,
  "typeofcover": 100,
  "policyholder": "SA",
  "policynumber": "SAPOL123",
  "commencingdate": "28/11/2025",
  "expiringdate": "29/11/2025",
  "registrationnumber": "KCW708R",
  "chassisnumber": "{{ChassisNumber}}",
  "phonenumber": "789789789",
  "bodytype": "{{BodyType}}",
  "tonnage": 1,
  "vehiclemake": "{{VehicleMake}}",
  "vehiclemodel": "{{VehicleModel}}",
  "enginenumber": "1NZ-D259850",
  "email": "chandrakala@swiftant.com",
  "suminsured": 100000,
  "insuredpin": "A123456789A",
  "yearofmanufacture": 2019,
  "hudumanumber": "123456789012",
  "licensedtocarry": 10
}

actualCNo
Email- CertificatePDFErrorER001 - Input json format is Incorrect

4  API Specifications
4.4  Issue Certificate - Member Company

4.4.9 Preview Type A certificates - Member Company
Version 1.8.1
 Purpose:To Issue Type A DMVIC certificate from the insurance companies’ core-system via DMVIC API
URL :   https://uat-api.dmvic.com/api/v6/Integration/PreviewTypeACertificate
Method : POST
Note: Please note that X509 client certificate should be installed in your server and to be attached to the header during every request of API
4.4.9.1  Request Body
4.4.9.1.2 Headers

Note: The parameters in the Request Elements are not case sensitive.

You cannot issue Future date.Kindly change datesExpiringdateYesstringDD/MM/YYYYRegistrationnumberNostringChassisnumberYesstringThe chassis number minimum length is 4 and maximum length is 20. 4  API Specifications
4.12  Issue Certificate - Intermediary

4.12.2 For Type B certificates - Intermediary
Version 1.8.1
URL :   https://uat-api.dmvic.com/api/v6/IntermediaryIntegration/IssuanceTypeBCertificate
Method : POST
Note: Please note that X509 client certificate should be installed in your server and to be attached to the header during every request of API
4.12.2.1  Request Body
4.12.2.1.1 Body
Note: The parameters in the Request Elements are not case sensitive.
ParameterMandatory (Yes / No)DatatypeData FormatValidation MessageMemberCompanyIDYesintExample: 11 MemberCompanyIDTypeofcoverYesint100Comprehensive (COMP)200Third-party (TPO)300Third-party, Theft & Fire (TPTF)Type of Cover is not validVehicleTypeYesint1MOTOR COMMERCIAL OWN GOODS2MOTOR COMMERCIAL GENERAL CARTAGE3MOTOR INSTITUTIONAL VEHICLE4MOTOR SPECIAL VEHICLES5TANKERS (LIQUID CARRYING)6MOTOR TRADE (ROAD RISK)PolicyholderYesstringpolicynumberYesstringCommencingdateYesstringDD/MM/YYYYCommencing Date is invalidExpiringdateYesstringDD/MM/YYYYRegistrationnumberNostringChassisnumberYesstringThe chassis number minimum length is 4 and maximum length is 20. Only accepts alphanumeric characters and does not support any special charactersPhonenumberYesstring999999999Please enter a valid Kenyan numberBodytypeYesstringTonnageCarryingCapacityYesintVehiclemakeNostringVehiclemodelNostringYearofregistrationMandatoryintYYYYEnginenumberNostringEmailYesstring<<Email id to which the Certificate pdf will be sent on successful Issuance>>Email is not validSumInsuredYes (when Comprehensive (COMP) & Third-party, Theft & Fire (TPTF))intInsuredPINYesstringInsured PIN number maximum length is 11YearofmanufactureNointYYYYHudumaNumberNostring123456789012New TonnageNew YesNew intNew LicensedtocarryNew YesNew intMembercompanyidYesint4.12.2.1.1 Response JSON (example)

ElementsDescriptionExampleInputsContains the input parameters specified by the query{HTTP Post Body}SuccessBit value true/false to differentiate if the request is succeeded or not.true/falsecallbackObjIf the request is succeeded, then the Json Object of the following parameters will be returned: TransactionNo, actualCNo, Email- CertificatePDFErrorER001 - Input json format is Incorrect,
ER002 - Unknown Error,
ER003 - Mandatory field is missing,
ER004 - Input not valid,
ER005 - Double Insurance,
ER006 - No sufficient Inventory,
ER007 - Data Validation ErrorAPIRequestNumberO-AA00014.12.2.3 Response JSON (example)

4  API Specifications
4.12  Issue Certificate - Intermediary

4.12.10 Preview Type B certificates - Intermediary
Version 1.8.1
URL :   https://uat-api.dmvic.com/api/v6/IntermediaryIntegration/PreviewTypeBCertificate
Method : POST
Note: Please note that X509 client certificate should be installed in your server and to be attached to the header during every request of API.
4.12.10.1  Request Body
4.12.10.1.1 Body
Note: The parameters in the Request Elements are not case sensitive.
ParameterMandatory (Yes / No)DatatypeData FormatValidation MessageMembercompanyidYesintExample: 11 MemberCompanyIDTypeofcoverYesint100Comprehensive (COMP)200Third-party (TPO)300Third-party, Theft & Fire (TPTF)Type of Cover is not validVehicleTypeYesint1MOTOR COMMERCIAL OWN GOODS2MOTOR COMMERCIAL GENERAL CARTAGE3MOTOR INSTITUTIONAL VEHICLE4MOTOR SPECIAL VEHICLES5MOTOR TANKERS (LIQUID CARRYING)6MOTOR TRADE (ROAD RISK)PolicyholderYesstringpolicynumberYesstringCommencingdateYesstringDD/MM/YYYYCommencing Date is invalidExpiringdateYesstringDD/MM/YYYYRegistrationnumberNostringChassisnumberYesstringThe chassis number minimum length is 4 and maximum length is 20. Only accepts alphanumeric characters and does not support any special charactersPhonenumberYesstring999999999Please enter a valid Kenyan numberBodytypeYesstringTonnageCarryingCapacityYesintVehiclemakeNostringVehiclemodelNostringYearofregistrationYesintYYYYEnginenumberNostringEmailYesstringEmail is not validSumInsuredYes (when Comprehensive (COMP) & Third-party, Theft & Fire (TPTF))intInsuredPINYesstringInsured PIN number maximum length is 11YearofmanufactureNointYYYYHudumaNumberNostring123456789012New TonnageNew YesNew intNew LicensedtocarryNew YesNew int Example Body content
{
  "Membercompanyid": 43,
  "VehicleType": 1,
  "Typeofcover": 100,
  "Policyholder": "SA",
  "policynumber": "SAPOL123",
  "Commencingdate": "28/10/2025",
  "Expiringdate": "18/12/2025",
  "Registrationnumber": "KCC379E",
  "Chassisnumber": "{{ChassisNumber}}",
  "Phonenumber": "789789789",
  "Bodytype": "{{BodyType}}",
  "Licensedtocarry": 9,
  "Vehiclemake": "{{VehicleMake}}",
  "Vehiclemodel": "{{VehicleModel}}",
  "Enginenumber": "{{EngineNumber}}",
  "Email": "xxxxxxx@dmvic.info",
  "SumInsured": 100000,
  "InsuredPIN": "A123456789A",
  "Yearofmanufacture": 2019,
  "HudumaNumber": "123456789012",
  "Tonnage": 1
}
4.12.10.1.2 Headers
Parameter nameMandatory (Yes / No)DatatypeData FormatAuthorizationYesstringBearer <<Token received from Login API on Successful login>>ClientIDYesstring<<Will be provided in a separate Email>>4.12.10.2 Response Elements
ElementsDescriptionExampleInputsContains the input parameters specified by the querySuccessBit value true/false to differentiate if the request is succeeded or not.true/falsecallbackObjIf the request is succeeded, then the Json Object of the following parameter will be returned: previewCertificateURLErrorER001 - Input json format is Incorrect,
ER002 - Unknown Error,
ER003 - Mandatory field is missing,
ER004 - Input not valid,
ER005 - Double Insurance,
ER006 - No sufficient Inventory,
ER007 - Data Validation ErrorAPIRequestNumberO-AA00014.12.10.3 Response JSON (example)

4  API Specifications
4.13  Validate Certificate - Intermediary

4.13.1 Validate Type A certificates - Intermediary
Version 1.8.1
URL :   https://uat-api.dmvic.com/api/v6/IntermediaryIntegration/ValidateTypeACertificate
Method : POST
Note: Please note that X509 client certificate should be installed in your server and to be attached to the header during every request of API
4.13.1.1  Request Body
4.13.1.1.1 Body
Note: The parameters in the Request Elements are not case sensitive.
ParameterMandatory (Yes / No)DatatypeData FormatValidation MessageTypeOfCertificateYesint1Class A - PSV Unmarked6Type A Bus7Type A Matatu8Type A TaxiType of certificate is wrongMemberCompanyIDYesintExample: 11 MemberCompanyIDTypeofcoverYesint100Comprehensive (COMP)200Third-party (TPO)300Third-party, Theft & Fire (TPTF)PolicyholderYesstringpolicynumberYesstringCommencingdateYesstringDD/MM/YYYY1Commencing Date is invalid2For the below types certificate cannot be issued with future dates Type-A Matatu, Type-A Bus. You cannot issue Future date.Kindly change datesExpiringdateYesstringDD/MM/YYYYRegistrationnumberNostringChassisnumberYesstringThe chassis number minimum length is 4 and maximum length is 20. Only accepts alphanumeric characters and does not support any special charactersPhonenumberYesstring999999999Please enter a valid Kenyan numberBodytypeYesstringLicensedtocarryYesintVehiclemakeNostringVehiclemodelNostringYearofregistrationYesintYYYYEnginenumberNostringEmailYesstring<<Email id to which the Certificate pdf will be sent on successful Issuance>>Email is not validSumInsuredYes (when Comprehensive (COMP) & Third-party, Theft & Fire (TPTF))intNew InsuredPINNew YesNew stringNew Insured PIN number maximum length is 11New YearofmanufactureNew NoNew intNew YYYYNew HudumaNumberNew NoNew stringNew 123456789012 Example Body content

  "Membercompanyid": 11,

  "Typeofcover": 100,
